id: title:Gilbert09:retry transient app db blips during import setup

review.posthog_relevance: Protects warehouse ingestion workflow from false-positive error reporting by distinguishing PostHog infrastructure transient failures from actual customer source failures.
review.reason: Adds a try/except block around warehouse import activity setup, catching Django ORM exceptions and re-raising them as NonReportableError. This prevents transient PostHog infrastructure errors (e.g., PgBouncer cooldown) from being recorded as customer source errors, allowing Temporal to retry without recording permanent failure. This is a substantive, bounded reliability improvement
